external_entities.name: Initiating Peer
external_entities.description: External peer initiating the RLPx connection with ephemeral keys and nonces
external_entities.trust_rationale: Network peers are untrusted by default; handshake protocol must validate their identity through cryptographic verification

external_entities.name: Remote Peer
external_entities.description: External Ethereum node sending hello packet with potentially different protocol version
external_entities.trust_rationale: Remote network peers can send any data; protocol uses forward-compatible parsing to handle unknown versions safely

external_entities.name: Discovery Peer
external_entities.description: External node sending UDP discovery packets with potentially unknown version or type
external_entities.trust_rationale: UDP discovery is unauthenticated and open to anyone; packets must be validated and size-limited

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External entity submitting raw transaction bytes
external_entities.trust_rationale: Transaction submitters can be anyone; transactions require full validation including signature verification before acceptance

external_entities.name: Transaction Signer
external_entities.description: Entity holding private key that signed the transaction
external_entities.trust_rationale: The signer is authenticated through valid ECDSA signature but their transaction intent still requires validation for gas, nonce, and format

external_entities.name: RPC Provider
external_entities.description: Third-party JSON-RPC endpoint that may or may not be trustworthy
external_entities.trust_rationale: The entire purpose of EIP-7919 is to remove trust requirements from RPC providers through cryptographic proofs

external_entities.name: ETH Sender
external_entities.description: User or contract sending native ETH
external_entities.trust_rationale: Users can send arbitrary transactions; system must validate signatures and balances

external_entities.name: Light Client
external_entities.description: Client querying logs without full node
external_entities.trust_rationale: Light clients are query-only and do not need trust level for serving data; they verify responses through proofs

external_entities.name: EIP Contributor
external_entities.description: Developer or community member submitting changes to an EIP document
external_entities.trust_rationale: Contributors submit through GitHub PR process which provides identity verification; their changes still require linting and review

misclassified_entities.name: Transaction Execution
misclassified_entities.description: EVM execution that produces transaction receipts
misclassified_entities.reason: This is an internal EVM process, not an external entity. Transaction execution is performed by the local node and produces receipts as part of normal operation.

coverage_analysis.notes: EXT-TX-SUBMITTER and EXT-TX-SIGNER are referenced in subgraph context but their incoming edges are implicit (transaction enters system at decode stage). Prague TX types subgraph starts at 'Raw Transaction Bytes Received' state.
